abstract: OBJECTIVE: To present an extremely rare case of sebaceous carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. CLINICAL PRESENTATION AND INTERVENTION: A 66-year-old woman presented with abdominal discomfort and a pelvic mass. Abdominal and pelvic ultrasound, as well as CT scan, revealed a 27 cm complex right pelvic mass, which was diagnosed histologically as a sebaceous carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma. The patient underwent a total abdominal hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, peritoneal washings, appendicectomy and infracolic omentectomy. CONCLUSION: This case adds to the rare reports in the literature of sebaceous carcinoma occurring in a mature cystic teratoma. The clinical behaviour and optimal management of this entity are not well established. The patient has been well for 32 months following surgery with no evidence of recurrent disease clinically.
abstract_ja: 目的：成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の卵巣に生じた皮脂腺癌の極めて稀な症例を報告すること。臨床経過と介入：66歳女性が腹部不快感と骨盤内腫瘤を主訴として受診した。腹部・骨盤超音波検査およびCTで、27cmの複雑な右骨盤内腫瘤が認められた。組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた皮脂腺癌と診断された。患者は子宮全摘術と両側卵管卵巣摘出術、腹腔洗浄細胞診、虫垂切除術、結腸下大網切除術を受けた。結論：本症例は、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に皮脂腺癌が生じた稀な報告例に加わるものである。本病態の臨床的挙動と最適な治療法は確立していない。患者は手術後32か月間、臨床的に再発の所見なく経過している。
